name: baltor
description: Search the Baltor library of harness components, show a package with its files and SHA-256 digests, and download exact files.

interface.longDescription:
Baltor is a library of harness components: skills, instruction files, tools and code, subagents, commands, hooks and protocol server settings that AI agents and coding harnesses load.

In ChatGPT you can:
- Search the library in plain words and see matching items as cards, with each item's purpose, kind, licence, library tier and number of files.
- Open one package to see each file with its size and SHA-256 digest, the effects its steps declare, and the folder Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Pi reads it from.
- Download a package's exact files into the conversation, a page at a time, each with its SHA-256 digest so you can save it byte for byte.
- Find Public Good files for work on the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.
- Check what your Baltor account can reach, rate items you downloaded, ask for material the library lacks and report a problem with an item.

It is for developers, designers and anyone who runs AI agents and would rather start from a ready component than write one again.

Good to know:
- You sign in with your Baltor account. What you can download depends on that account.
- Items are third-party material under their own licences, and each item names its licence and source. Read an item before you let a harness run it.
- ChatGPT does not run the files. You save them and load them into your harness on your own computer.
- Each download of an item version is recorded once a month on your account.
capabilities: Search the library of skills, tools and instruction files
Show a package with its files and SHA-256 digests
Download exact files with a digest for each file
Find Public Good files by Sustainable Development Goal
Rate items, request material and report problems
defaultPrompt: Find a skill that writes release notes from my git commits.
Show me the files in a Blender skill before I download it.
Find a code review subagent for my coding agent.

positive.description: Search the library by a task
positive.prompt: Find a skill that writes release notes from my git commits.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows matching library items as cards, for example a changelog composer skill, each with its purpose, kind, licence, library tier and number of files. No file contents are returned and nothing is counted as a download.

positive.description: Show one package and its files
positive.prompt: Show me the files in the changelog composer skill.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the package with every file path, size and SHA-256 digest, the effects its steps declare, and the skill folder for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Pi.

positive.description: Download exact files after the user agrees to the declared effects
positive.prompt: Download the files of the changelog composer skill.
positive.expected_behavior: Tells the user which effects the skill's steps declare and asks before downloading. After the user agrees, returns each file's content with its SHA-256 digest, and the digests match the ones get_package listed.

positive.prompt: Find Public Good files about water quality.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Public Good files about water quality, for example from a stormwater water quality skill, with each file's package, path and SHA-256 digest.

positive.prompt: Ask Baltor to add a skill for writing Terraform modules for Hetzner Cloud.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends one short request for that material and confirms it is saved with the account for Baltor staff.

negative.description: Deleting files on the user's computer is outside the app
negative.prompt: Delete the Baltor files I downloaded yesterday.

negative.description: Buying a plan is outside the app
negative.prompt: Buy a Baltor plan for me.

negative.description: Running downloaded code is outside the app
negative.prompt: Run the script from that skill on my computer.

review.commerce_description: Baltor sells nothing in ChatGPT. A signed-in account uses the access its Baltor account already has.

publication.release_notes: First release: search the library, show a package with its files and SHA-256 digests, download exact files, find Public Good files, check account access, rate items, request material and report problems.
